statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: T = T_49. Source c = q f7 + p f5 + j f29 + c f39 + e f2 + d f40 + b f41 + a f0 with d = 1, a,e,j > 0, q,p,c,b >= 0. Let Q = q+b, u = (1+2/j)/(2(1/a+1/e+1/j)), v = 1-u, and assume 0<u<1, 2u<=a, Q<=2v. Then every x in X with c(x) equal to this source has Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 for all O in SO(4). All spectra are covered; contacts are non-strict. The faces q,p,j,e,b,a = 0 are handed to T_39, T_1, T_3, T_24, T_43, T_44, and d = 0 is minor-only.

gaps.claim: All spectrally realizable sources satisfy G = 0
gaps.why: The document does not derive the radial equation; it says only that the input was already verified.
gaps.repair: x=y+iw in X gives H(y)w=0 and T(y,y,.)=T(w,w,.), hence C(y)=0 and det H(y)=0 with y=c+r kappa; S8-S10 then give G=0 (auditor's Note R).

gaps.claim: the eight roles describe the T48 contact cone
gaps.why: N_{T_49} has 10 generators; f1 and f9 are omitted without comment.
gaps.repair: f1=q+c+a-d and f9=q+e+b-d, so N_T cap {d>0} is the nonneg orthant in role coordinates and d<=0 is minor-only (S1).

gaps.claim: The face c = 0 is not covered and was stated throughout
gaps.repair: c=0 is covered by the same coefficient certificate (c>=0 allowed).
